property_mix.era: mixed Victorian and Edwardian with substantial post-war infill and modern development
property_mix.notable: Significant Victorian and Edwardian seafront villas; high density of HMO conversions and student lettings. Large post-war suburban estates inland.

locksmith_relevant: Victorian villas often feature original sash windows and period locks requiring specialist knowledge and careful handling.
Heavy student HMO concentration means frequent emergency callouts for shared house lockouts and bulk rekeying work.
Coastal properties experience accelerated corrosion; marine air degrades locks faster, driving higher maintenance and replacement demand.
